state.goal: Choose a storage engine for the notes product as it grows
state.question: Which storage approach should the notes product standardize on?
evidence: current usage is one local user
a public multi-user version is under consideration but not decided
either storage approach can serve the current usage

alternatives.name: SQLite
alternatives.description: An embedded relational database stored in a single file, simplest for the current single-user usage.

alternatives.name: PostgreSQL
alternatives.description: A client-server relational database ready for many concurrent users from the start.
disadvantages: requires running and operating a server today
